data.one_liner: Algolia search API client for Dart and Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The Algolia Search API Client allows you to build a seamless search and discovery experience in your Dart or Flutter app. It provides tools for configuring and executing search requests to the Algolia API, offering features like instant search results, search-as-you-type, and typo-tolerance.
use_when: You need to integrate Algolia search functionality into your Dart or Flutter application.
You want search-as-you-type and typo-tolerant search features backed by Algolia.
avoid_when: You do not use Algolia as your search backend.
You prefer an entirely local search database without a cloud search provider.
strengths: Provides official search-specific functionalities for Algolia in Dart and Flutter.
Supports instant search results and typo-tolerance out of the box.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Algolia backend ecosystem.
Requires an active internet connection and Algolia subscription to function.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to your pubspec.yaml using `flutter pub add algolia_client_search` and configure your Algolia credentials.
